scope: Source-derived analysis detail for the registered unchanged-physics trace. Written after capture started, before raw stage outcomes were inspected; not a new prospective physical acceptance threshold.
ordinary: Distinguish applied correction from requested correction, exact opposing-component velocity clipping, raw impulse budget sum of lengths, age scaling/cap3, float32 per-proxy motion threshold length_squared>1e-6, receipt proposed sum including skipped tiny impulses, and actual momentum/angular momentum after clipping. Exact body-state differences are primary; Python float32 wrench model residual is diagnostic, not a pass/fail tolerance that may be tuned to outcomes. Maximum admitted ordinary sample age remains8; correction age remains1.
energy: E=K-M*g dot worldCOM; attribute signed and positive energy changes across the three operators, correction potential and clipping loss separately. Telescope is an arithmetic check, not a conservation acceptance. Numeric telescope bound is256*binary64_epsilon*max(1,abs(stage energies)), derived from the subtraction/sum count and never adjusted to measurements.
normalization: Signed upward impulse=-J dot unit(g); divide by M*|g|*actual bridge fixed_delta. Window denominator includes every physical step, including missing/refused/sleeping frames. Zero gravity is undefined. Nominal mg/60 is separate. Ratio does not calibrate Sand grain weight or establish native-only support force.
controls: Analytic clipping opposing/aligned, central and opposite-offset impulse torque, magnitude rather than net cap budget, tiny impulse threshold, correction potential vs clipping loss, signed/zero-gravity normalization and nonconservative telescope. Existing actual Rapier33-check compound fixture covers clipping/offcentre/stale/duplicate guards. Additional adverse trace mutations must be rejected before public analysis.
limits: S0 of each step must equal prior postRapier rigid bits; same body/generation/epoch/M/I and0/1midpoint; disabled/preapplication-refused Sand mutation-free; one actual Rapier step. Cached hard contacts not summed. No force-law change from a measured sustaining cycle without separate registration.
